title: `check:published-dist`'s own remedy text tells you to "leave it at its default (the package root)" — but for a package with an `outDir` the default IS inside `dist`
body:
Filed unassigned by the dev seat implementing objectui#9189. Routing, `domain:*`, `type` and grading are the triage seat's to produce. Not caused by that card's diff; that card's diff is what made this readable.

## The measurement

`scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs` emits this remedy when it finds a build record in a published output directory (the `tooling-in-published-output` hint, near the end of the file):

> point that package's `tsBuildInfoFile` outside the published build output, **or leave it at its default (the package root)**, since `files: ["dist", ...]` publishes that directory whole

The second half is false for exactly the packages that can trigger this finding. TypeScript derives the default from `outDir` and `rootDir`:

- `outDir` set, `rootDir` **not** set, which is the shape of all 18 affected projects, gives `outDir/CONFIGNAME.tsbuildinfo` — i.e. **inside `dist`**, not the package root.
- `outDir` set **and** `rootDir` set rebases the derived path back out, and that is the only reason the other 12 projects were ever correct.

Measured at `c64975e9f` with TypeScript's own `getTsBuildInfoEmitOutputFilePath` over every tracked tsconfig: 32 incremental projects, 18 of them deriving into `dist`.

So "leave it at its default" is advice that, followed literally by a reader whose package is in the affected shape, reproduces the finding it is the remedy for. The remedy only works via its first half — set the option explicitly.

## Why it is worth a card

The hint is printed at exactly the moment a reader has no other information: the gate is red, the record has no tooling source to trace, and this paragraph is the whole explanation. A reader who trusts the parenthetical concludes their default is already the package root and goes looking for a different cause.

It is small and text-only, which is why it is filed rather than ridden along on objectui#9189 — that card's ruling was explicitly scoped to the tsconfigs, and a gate's normative text is a different file with its own pin tests.

## Shape of a change (not a ruling)

Probably: keep the first half, and replace the parenthetical with the actual rule — the default follows `outDir`/`rootDir`, so it is the package root only when `rootDir` is set. Whether the same sentence in the `BUILD_RECORD` docblock needs the same treatment is the triage seat's call.

Reported from a Claude Code dev session, session id `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`.
